chapter.title: Meet Kamski
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 at flowchart-node level from the PowerPyx 100% chart (33 nodes) and the detroitbecometext template (8 prompts, 8 arrows, 3 observations). Two starts: WAIT FOR HANK if Connor died in Public Enemy (Hank small down), else ARRIVE WITH HANK → GET OUT OF CAR → LEARN CHRIS IS DEAD / SURVIVED (Capitol Park). Then FOLLOW HANK TO KAMSKI’S PLACE (one prompt), CHLOE ANSWERS DOOR → ENTER LOBBY → CHLOE GOES TO GET KAMSKI, [ WAIT FOR KAMSKI ] (two rounds with Hank; the Amanda photo, the painting and a sculpture; the two magazines once the photo is analyzed), CHLOE RETURNS → MEET KAMSKI → QUESTION KAMSKI (three rounds; DEFENSIVE and TROUBLED give instability small up), KAMSKI TEST: SHOOT CHLOE (instability and Hank large down; one question: rA9, Jericho location, or virus; the Jericho answer gives the key) or SPARE CHLOE (instability large up; Hank large up on leaving). Kamski’s emergency-exit line plays on both paths. Endings HANK WAS DISAPPOINTED WITH CONNOR’S DECISION and HANK THOUGHT CONNOR MADE THE RIGHT DECISION. No Amanda or public-opinion change. Researched in docs/research/ch27-meet-kamski.md.

decisions.title: Wait for Hank (checkpoint) and Hank isn’t pleased to see Connor
decisions.context: Connor died in Public Enemy; the replacement waits outside Kamski’s villa and Hank arrives alone. “Still immortal, huh Connor?” if Connor has died more than once, otherwise “You died in my arms… Fuck you.”

options.label: Scripted, no choice
options.effect: Hank small down.

decisions.gate: Condition tab CONNOR DIED IN ‘PUBLIC ENEMY’.
decisions.note: Start A. Template: “Hank arrives alone”, ARROW Hank SmallDown; the cut “I couldn’t decide whether I wanted you to come back” is not built.

benchmark.note: A narrated event; the greeting follows the death count. Reads a chapter 24 flag ch24ConnorDied first, then legacy publicEnemyConnorDied if present, else the current Public Enemy scenes.

decisions.title: Arrive with Hank (checkpoint), Get out of car, Learn Chris is dead / survived
decisions.context: Connor did not die in Public Enemy and arrives in Hank’s car; Hank has been on the phone and tells him about Officer Chris Miller, attacked on patrol last night.

options.label: COPS KILLED IN ‘CAPITOL PARK’
options.effect: LEARN CHRIS IS DEAD: executed with his own service weapon; he had just become a father.

options.label: COPS SPARED IN ‘CAPITOL PARK’
options.effect: LEARN CHRIS SURVIVED: “He said he was saved by Markus himself.”

decisions.gate: Connor did not die in Public Enemy; the news follows the Capitol Park choice.
decisions.note: Start B. No arrow. The crowd always kills when Markus leaves it to them.

benchmark.note: A narrated event; Hank’s news is the outcome and a fact Connor keeps. No news if the Capitol Park choice is missing.

decisions.title: Follow Hank to Kamski’s place: the walk to the door
decisions.context: One prompt on the path to the door.

options.label: INSTINCT
options.effect: “I have a bad feeling, lieutenant.”

options.label: LEAD
options.effect: How did Hank find Kamski?

options.label: KAMSKI
options.effect: Why meet a man who left CyberLife ten years ago?

options.label: CHRIS
options.effect: Only if Connor arrived alone: what happened to Officer Chris.

decisions.note: No arrow on any option. CHRIS requires “Connor and Hank arrived separately”.

benchmark.note: One pick (whether several can be asked is undocumented).

decisions.title: Chloe answers door, Enter lobby, Chloe goes to get Kamski
decisions.context: An RT600 opens the door: “I’ll let Elijah know you’re here. But please, make yourself comfortable.”

options.label: Scripted, no choice
options.effect: None.

decisions.title: Talk to Hank: two rounds in the lobby
decisions.context: Hank: “Nice girl…”, then “So, you’re about to meet your maker, Connor. How does it feel?”

options.label: SINCERE / ANALYTICAL / INDIFFERENT
options.effect: Reply to “Nice girl…”. No arrow.

options.label: IMPATIENT / DISTANT / INDIFFERENT
options.effect: Reply to “meet your maker”. No arrow.

decisions.gate: [ WAIT FOR KAMSKI ]; PowerPyx: happens automatically.

benchmark.note: Two decision scenes before the lobby can be explored (the template’s order).

decisions.title: Wait for Kamski: the photo of Amanda, the painting, the sculpture
decisions.context: Optional scans while waiting. ANALYZE PORTRAIT (the framed photo by the door): Amanda Stern, AI professor at Colbridge, died 02/23/27, with her student Elijah Kamski; Connor: “Amanda…”. ANALYZE PAINTING: Kamski, CyberLife founder, resigned 2028, inventor of Thirium. ANALYZE SCULPTURE.

options.label: ANALYZE PORTRAIT
options.effect: Unlocks the magazines, and AMANDA’S PICTURE with Amanda in Last Chance.

options.label: ANALYZE PAINTING
options.effect: The Kamski scan card.

options.label: ANALYZE SCULPTURE
options.effect: No card.

decisions.note: The template and PowerPyx use “portrait” for different objects; the wiki ties ANALYZE PORTRAIT to Amanda’s Picture.

benchmark.note: A repeatable lobby scene; the photo sets kamskiAmandaPhoto; waiting ends it.

decisions.title: Read “Space Tourism” and “Fortune Teller”
decisions.context: Two Tech Addict issues on the table under the photo: space tourism for the rich (Clear Skies); CyberLife’s quantum ‘Fortune Teller’ computer.

options.label: READ “SPACE TOURISM”
options.effect: No stat change.

options.label: READ “FORTUNE TELLER”
options.effect: No stat change.

decisions.gate: After analyzing the photo (PowerPyx, IGN; the wiki’s magazine pages say the painting).

benchmark.note: A media scene reached from the lobby when the magazines are picked up; it returns to the lobby.

decisions.title: Chloe returns, Meet Kamski, Question Kamski
decisions.context: At the pool Kamski calls deviants “perfect beings with infinite intelligence”, then asks Connor whose side he is on and what he really wants.

options.label: HELP / DEVIANTS / VIRUS / WAR
options.effect: Connor’s opening question. No arrow.

options.label: NEUTRAL / DEFENSIVE / DIRECT
options.effect: “Whose side are you on?” DEFENSIVE: instability small up.

options.label: AGGRESSIVE / DEFENSIVE / TROUBLED / NEUTRAL
options.effect: “What do you really want?” DEFENSIVE and TROUBLED: instability small up.

decisions.note: The wiki’s Software Instability page names only the second question; the template has the small up on DEFENSIVE in both.

benchmark.note: One event and three decision scenes; at most two small ups on one path.

decisions.title: Kamski test: shoot Chloe for information?
decisions.context: Kamski has Chloe kneel and puts a gun in Connor’s hand: “Destroy this machine and I’ll tell you all I know. Or spare it, if you feel it’s alive.” Hank: “Connor, don’t…”

options.label: SHOOT
options.effect: Instability large down, Hank large down; Kamski answers one question.

options.label: DON’T SHOOT
options.effect: Instability large up; Hank large up when they leave. “CyberLife’s last chance to save humanity... is itself a deviant.”

decisions.note: Chart nodes KAMSKI TEST, SHOOT CHLOE, SPARE CHLOE. No Amanda change in this chapter.

benchmark.note: Decision scene with the game’s buttons; the earlier Amanda changes are removed.

decisions.title: Which question to ask Kamski?

options.label: rA9
options.effect: KAMSKI IS CRYPTIC: “Maybe it’s a messiah. Maybe it’s just a myth…”

options.label: JERICHO LOCATION
options.effect: KAMSKI OFFERS JERICHO KEY THROUGH CHLOE, DOWNLOAD JERICHO KEY: Last Chance skips the archive.

options.label: VIRUS
options.effect: KAMSKI IS CRYPTIC: a copy error spread through androids’ identification data.

decisions.note: No arrow on any answer; Amanda’s reaction comes in Last Chance.

benchmark.note: Three options in the game’s order; the Jericho answer sets kamskiLocation, jerichoLocated and raid.

decisions.title: Leave Kamski’s house: the two endings
decisions.context: Kamski: “By the way… I always leave an emergency exit in my programs… You never know…” Then Hank, in the snow.

options.label: HANK WAS DISAPPOINTED WITH CONNOR’S DECISION
options.effect: Shot Chloe: “A machine! That’s what you are!”

options.label: HANK THOUGHT CONNOR MADE THE RIGHT DECISION
options.effect: Spared Chloe: “Maybe you did the right thing.” Hank large up.

decisions.note: The template places the emergency-exit line after the test, on both paths (the Connor wiki page puts it on sparing only).

benchmark.note: Two narrated events; the exit line is a fact on both; kamskiOutcome records the ending.
